concept.zh: 国际主义字体风格：穆勒-布罗克曼的苏黎世音乐厅海报、鲁德的《排印月刊》、《新平面设计》杂志。一切服从模数网格，左齐右不齐，标题是排好的字块而不是装饰。红与黑、01/02 的编号本身就是结构——客观、冷静，让信息自己说话。
concept.en: The International Typographic Style: Müller-Brockmann’s Zürich Tonhalle posters, Emil Ruder’s Typographische Monatsblätter, the Neue Grafik journal. Everything answers to a modular grid, flush-left and ragged-right; headlines are typeset blocks, not decoration. Red, black and numbered sections are the structure — objective, cool, letting the information speak.

references: Josef Müller-Brockmann, Zürich Tonhalle “musica viva” concert posters (1951–1972)
Emil Ruder, Typographie: A Manual of Design (1967)
Neue Grafik / New Graphic Design journal (1958–1965)
Josef Müller-Brockmann, Grid Systems in Graphic Design (1981)
Karl Gerstner, Designing Programmes (1964)

tokens.grid: 12 columns grouped into 6 fields, 24px gutter, 48px outer margin (24px on mobile); 8px baseline with body 16/24; every block top-aligns to a field row of 8 baselines (64px).
tokens.radius: 0 everywhere — buttons, images and inputs included.
tokens.border: 1px solid ink hairlines only on field boundaries; one 6px accent bar (exactly one field wide) as the only heavy rule; never a box around text.

must: All text is flush-left, ragged-right; nothing centred or justified.
Every element’s left edge lands on a declared column line (≤ 6 distinct x-positions per screen).
A numeric system (01, 02 … or dates/times as large figures) organises the page.
At most two type sizes per section besides the headline.
mustNot: No centred headline and no symmetrical hero.
No decorative imagery: photos are objective (object, building, person straight-on) or absent; no illustrations, no textures behind text.
No more than one accent colour plus black inside the same field.
No rounded corners, shadows or icons.

voice.description: 访谈稿：问句短，答句是当事人的原话风格，具体、口语、有细节。
voice.example: 问：为什么周一休息？答：酵种也要歇一天。

layout.name: Numbered index
layout.description: Numbers are the architecture: each section opens with a giant numeral spanning two columns with the content to its right; the page reads like a specification.
layout.grid: 8 columns, 16px gutters, 40px margins; numeral column = cols 1–2 (numerals 12–18vw, tabular), content cols 3–8; 8px baseline.
structure: Top band: title flush-left, a 6px red bar spanning cols 1–2 only
01 — giant red numeral left; statement and key facts right
02 — a ruled table (label / value / note)
03 — one objective black-and-white image or a solid colour field cropped to the grid
04 — contact as plain lines, numbered like everything else

anchor.name: Geometric field
anchor.description: An abstract figure (concentric arcs, a circle cut by the grid, or stacked bars) fills ≈60% of the first screen; the text is small and sits in two fields at the bottom-left.

type.name: Archivo (Akzidenz stand-in)
type.notes: Headlines 800, sentence case, tracking -0.02em, line-height 0.95, set as a block of 3–5 lines. Body 16/24, weight 400, never justified. Numerals tabular (font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums). Only three sizes on a page: headline, body, 12px caption.

stacks.display: Archivo, "Noto Sans SC", "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif
stacks.body: Archivo, "Noto Sans SC", "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif

palette.name: Tonhalle night
palette.usage: Black concert poster: off-white type (≈85% of marks); orange for the main arc or numeral; blue only as one secondary overlapping figure; never more than two accent shapes per screen.

density.description: 大留白，一屏只讲一件事；正文行长 60–68 字符（中文 30–36 字）。

motion.name: Rule draw
motion.description: Only on the first screen, once on load: hairlines and the accent bar extend from the left margin to their column end (scaleX 0→1, transform-origin left). Type never moves.
motion.reduced: Rules are drawn at full length immediately.

motif.name: Section numerals
motif.description: Two-digit numerals (01, 02 …) in the display weight at 4–6× body size, tabular figures, hanging in the left column; they double as navigation.

surface.name: Uncoated offset
surface.description: Flat uncoated stock, no texture; colours print solid with razor edges.

twist.description: 首屏不出现任何按钮；行动入口（电话、预订、地址）在第二屏之后，以文字链接或表格行出现。

concept.zh: 时装画册与巴黎版 Vogue 的编辑版面：Didone 字体在极大和极小之间来回切换，发丝细线，大片留白，字极少。每一页只有一个主体，按 LOOK 01、02……编号，像走秀出场顺序。
concept.en: The fashion lookbook and the Vogue Paris editorial spread: a Didone face swinging between enormous and tiny, hairline rules, vast whitespace, very few words. Each page holds one subject, numbered LOOK 01, 02… in runway order.

references: Vogue Paris covers and editorial spreads (1970s–2000s)
Alexey Brodovitch — Harper's Bazaar (1934–58)
Fabien Baron — Harper's Bazaar redesign (1992)
Jil Sander and Maison Martin Margiela lookbooks (1990s)
M/M (Paris) — Yohji Yamamoto catalogues

tokens.grid: 12 col, 40px gutters, 8vw outer margins, 8px baseline; blocks snap to columns, and whole columns are left empty on purpose.
tokens.border: Hairlines only: 1px at 40% ink (or 0.5px on 2× screens); no boxes around anything.

must: The first screen has at least a 15:1 ratio between its largest and smallest type size.
At least 50% of the first screen is empty paper.
Every section carries a look or page number.
mustNot: No paragraph longer than 60 words on any one page; no bullet lists.
No boxes, cards, filled buttons or badges; links are underlined words or numbers.
No mid-size type between 16 and 64px except one italic standfirst.

voice.description: 观察者的记录：带日期、时间、度量和第一手细节，克制、不评价。
voice.example: 06:40 — 窗内温度 31°C，面团第二次发酵完成（目测体积 ×2）。

layout.name: Look sequence
layout.description: Each section is one "look": a single image or a single block of text placed asymmetrically on an otherwise empty page, with its look number.
layout.grid: 12 col; each look occupies 4–6 columns, alternating left/right; one look per 100vh on desktop.
structure: Cover: title at ~22vw running past the right margin, season line in 11px caps on its baseline
LOOK 01: image on 5 columns at the right, number and a two-line caption bottom-left
LOOK 02: text-only — one sentence at 6vw italic, nothing else on the page
LOOK 03: two narrow images on 3 columns each separated by a hairline
Credits page: tiny two-column list of credits / facts in small caps around a centred vertical hairline

anchor.name: Giant initial
anchor.description: One initial or numeral at ~70vh in hairline Didone filling the left half; the right half empty except a three-line caption.

type.name: Italiana + Cormorant Garamond
type.notes: Italiana uppercase for titles, tracking 0.12em, 64–180px; look numbers in Italiana at 10vw. Cormorant Garamond 300 italic for standfirsts at 28–36px, 400 roman for body 18px/1.6. Never bold anything.

stacks.body: "Cormorant Garamond", "Noto Serif SC", Garamond, Georgia, serif

palette.name: Noir & champagne
palette.usage: Evening-collection black; ivory type; champagne for the masthead and look numbers (~4%); deep red only as a single fill behind one image.

density.description: 大留白，一屏只讲一件事；正文行长 60–68 字符（中文 30–36 字）。

motion.name: Runway step
motion.description: On hover a look steps forward: image scale 1 → 1.015 while its caption hairline draws from 0 to full width.
motion.reduced: Only the hairline appears; no scale.

motif.name: Scale collision
motif.description: A 200px+ word sharing a baseline with 11px caps text set directly against it.

surface.name: Tissue interleaf
surface.description: A tissue sheet over the cover: a paper-coloured layer at 82% opacity (no blur) laid over the first image, its lower edge slightly deckled.
surface.css: .tissue { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--paper) 82%, transparent); clip-path: polygon(0 0, 100% 0, 100% 97%, 80% 99%, 55% 97%, 30% 100%, 0 98%); }

twist.description: 强调色在全页最多出现 3 处；其余一切只用 ink / paper / rule。

trace.note: primary branch (or its family) already used in this roll; walked forward 1 step(s)

concept.zh: 剧院、铁路与电影院的票据：存根和票身之间一条打孔线，流水号、排号、座号、日期都关在小格子里，底下压着防伪扭索纹。信息很密，但每一项都有固定位置；撕下来的那一半，就是凭证。
concept.en: Theatre, railway and cinema tickets: a perforated line between stub and body, serial, row, seat and date each locked in a small ruled cell, a guilloche security pattern underneath. Dense with information, yet every item has a fixed place — and the half you tear off is the proof.

references: Edmondson railway card tickets (1840s–1990, British Rail)
Broadway hard tickets & Ticketron stubs (1970s–80s)
Globe Ticket Co. "ADMIT ONE" roll tickets
中国铁路硬板票与红色软纸火车票
Odeon cinema tickets (1950s)

tokens.grid: Ticket module at a 4:1 ratio (e.g. 960×240): body 75% + stub 25%; inside, an 8-column cell grid with 1px rules; the page is a stack of modules with 24px gaps.
tokens.radius: 0 on corners. Stubs get semicircular notches at both ends of the perforation via radial-gradient(circle at 0 50%, transparent 10px, var(--panel) 10.5px).
tokens.border: 1px solid rule for cells; perforation = a row of 4px holes every 8px (or 2px dotted rule); ticket outline 1.5px solid ink.
tokens.shadow: none. Tickets lie flat on the page.

must: Every section is a ticket module with a perforated split into body and stub.
All numbers (dates, times, prices, rows, seats) sit in labelled 1px-ruled cells and use tabular figures.
Serial numbers are derived from a real fact such as the date (Nº 20261101), never a fake count.
mustNot: No rounded-rectangle cards; ticket corners are square or notched only.
No information floating outside a ticket module except a page-level header.
No QR codes or barcodes that encode nothing; use guilloche and serials instead.

voice.description: 观察者的记录：带日期、时间、度量和第一手细节，克制、不评价。
voice.example: 06:40 — 窗内温度 31°C，面团第二次发酵完成（目测体积 ×2）。

layout.name: Oversized card ticket
layout.description: The first screen is one enormous Edmondson card ticket (57:30) with FROM → TO, class, fare and a dating-press stamp; the rest of the page reads as its reverse side.
layout.grid: Card max 1100px at 1.9:1 with an internal 12-col cell grid and 1px rules; the reverse side below uses 2 columns at 1:2.
structure: Card front: issuing company small caps at top, FROM → TO huge, class and fare in cells, serial top-right
Dating-press stamp: the date embossed at −8° overprinting a corner of the card
Reverse side: conditions of issue in two narrow columns of 11px type
Timetable or fare table with dot leaders
Inspector's clip: a bite-shaped notch cut from one edge of the card

anchor.name: Admit-one ticket
anchor.description: The first screen is one huge ticket (body + stub) with the subject as the event title and the real date/time in the stub.

type.name: Bevan + Old Standard TT
type.notes: Theatre hard-ticket voice. Bevan for the production title in upper/lower case, line-height 1.0. Old Standard TT small caps +0.12em for ORCHESTRA / ROW / SEAT labels, 16px/1.45 body, lining figures; prices with the currency sign at 60% size, raised.

stacks.body: "Old Standard TT", "Noto Serif SC", Georgia, serif

palette.name: Buff railway card
palette.usage: Buff pressboard; black text; a green horizontal band for class (~12%); orange-red for the dating-press stamp and one route arrow; panel = the reverse side.

lines.verdict: large text / UI marks only (≥24px or bold ≥19px)

density.description: 像报纸/促销单一样塞满：几乎没有空白区，靠字号反差、粗线和色块分区。

motion.name: Dating press
motion.description: The date stamp lands in two frames: scale 1.15 → 1 while settling at −8°.

motif.name: Guilloche underprint
motif.description: A fine SVG guilloche of overlapping sine rosettes (0.5px strokes in accent2 at ~25% tone) behind the ticket body as a security pattern.

surface.name: Security paper
surface.description: Concentric fine-line rosettes behind all text panels, like banknote paper.
surface.css: background-image: repeating-radial-gradient(circle at 30% 50%, transparent 0 6px, color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent2) 18%, transparent) 6px 6.6px);

twist.description: 首屏不出现任何按钮；行动入口（电话、预订、地址）在第二屏之后，以文字链接或表格行出现。

concept.zh: 8 位与 16 位游戏的说明书和像素界面：双线边框的对话框、HP/MP 条、手柄按键示意图、道具清单，以及有限的调色板——Game Boy 的四阶绿、FC 的 54 色。限制让每一个像素都有意义。
concept.en: Manuals and pixel UIs of 8- and 16-bit games: double-bordered dialogue boxes, HP/MP bars, controller diagrams, item lists and limited palettes — the Game Boy's four greens, the NES's 54 colours. Constraint makes every pixel mean something.

references: Nintendo Entertainment System instruction booklets (1985–94)
Dragon Quest / Dragon Warrior (Enix, 1986) command windows
Nintendo Game Boy DMG-01 (1989) screen and manuals
Final Fantasy VI (Square, 1994) menu screens
Nintendo Power magazine maps and strategy pages (1988–)

tokens.grid: Tile grid: 8px tiles scaled ×3 (24px) on desktop, ×2 (16px) on mobile; every size, gap and border is a multiple of the scaled pixel; a screen is 32 × 28 tiles (NES 256 × 224).
tokens.radius: 0 — window corners are notched by one scaled pixel with clip-path polygon, never CSS-rounded.
tokens.border: Windows: double border — 3px line, 3px gap, 3px line (border: 9px double var(--ink); on dark windows border-color: var(--paper)); image-rendering: pixelated on every bitmap.
tokens.shadow: Hard one-tile drop (8px 8px 0 var(--rule)) on screenshot boxes only; no blur anywhere.

must: All sizes, gaps and borders are multiples of the scaled pixel/tile.
No more than four colours in any one screen area.
At least one double-border window with a ▶ cursor or ▼ prompt.
Pixel fonts only at native multiples; long text uses the body face.
mustNot: No anti-aliased or fractionally scaled pixel art; image-rendering: pixelated.
No real console logos, trademarked characters or sprites from actual games.
No gradients except a two-colour ordered dither.
Stat bars never show invented numbers.

voice.description: 访谈稿：问句短，答句是当事人的原话风格，具体、口语、有细节。
voice.example: 问：为什么周一休息？答：酵种也要歇一天。

layout.name: Strategy-guide spread
layout.description: A Nintendo Power-style spread: a world map drawn as tiles with numbered callouts and a sidebar of matching tip boxes.
layout.grid: 12-col spread; map panel 8 col × 6 rows of 48px tiles; sidebar 4 col with numbered tip boxes; callouts as 32px squares.
structure: Title band with a stage number ("WORLD 1-1" pattern used for section numbering)
Tile map with numbered callouts over it
Numbered tip boxes matching the callouts
Stats table for the facts that have real numbers
A "secret" note at the bottom in a dashed box

anchor.name: Dialogue opening
anchor.description: A full-width dialogue box in the lower third with a name tag, typing the first fact, under a small pixel scene drawn in CSS/SVG.

type.name: Press Start 2P + Chakra Petch
type.notes: Press Start 2P only at multiples of 8px (16/24/32/48), uppercase, line-height 1.5, never for paragraphs; -webkit-font-smoothing: none. Chakra Petch for booklet text 16–17px/1.5, 600 for button names (A, B, START, SELECT).

palette.name: Title-screen black
palette.usage: Black title screen; white text; orange for the title and selected menu item; sky blue for bars and the ▼ prompt; windows pure black with a white double border.

density.description: 常规阅读节奏；区块之间用明确的分隔（线、色块或编号），不靠空白硬撑。

motion.name: Bar fill
motion.description: Stat bars showing real values fill tile by tile on load, one step per 8px segment.
motion.reduced: Bars drawn at their final value.

motif.name: Double-border window
motif.description: Dialogue and command windows: solid fill, double border (3px line, 3px gap, 3px line), notched corners, ▶ cursor and ▼ prompt drawn as pixel triangles.

surface.name: Ordered dither
surface.description: A 2×2 checker dither between two palette colours — the only permitted "gradient".
surface.css: background-image: conic-gradient(var(--accent) 25%, var(--panel) 0 50%, var(--accent) 0 75%, var(--panel) 0); background-size: 4px 4px; image-rendering: pixelated;

twist.description: 每个区块有显眼的编号（§1、No.2、03…），编号本身是设计元素。

concept.zh: 老通书与撕页黄历：米黄纸上红黑两色套印，竖排文字从右往左读，干支纪日的方框、宜与忌对开的格子、角上一方朱印；月份牌则把节气与日期框进木刻花边。每一项都有固定的位置，读者凭位置就知道去哪里找。
concept.en: The traditional tongshu almanac and the tear-off huangli: red and black ink on rice paper, vertical text read right to left, boxes for the ganzhi day, paired grids of 宜 (do) and 忌 (avoid), a cinnabar seal in the corner; the yuefenpai calendar poster frames dates and solar terms in woodblock borders. Every item has a fixed place, so readers find things by position alone.

references: 通书 / 通勝 almanacs, Qing woodblock editions and Hong Kong 蔡真步堂 editions
《時憲書》 Qing imperial calendar, woodblock printed
撕页日历 tear-off daily calendars, mainland China 1960s–90s
月份牌 Shanghai calendar posters — 郑曼陀, 杭穉英 (1910s–30s)
《芥子园画传》 woodblock page frames and fish-tail 版心

tokens.grid: Woodblock page grid: a framed block (版框) divided into vertical columns (行) of 1em + 0.5em with 1px dividers (界栏), read right to left with writing-mode: vertical-rl; horizontal Latin blocks outside the frame on a 12-col, 16px-gutter grid.
tokens.radius: 0. Seals are squares or circles; nothing else is round.
tokens.border: Frame: 4px solid var(--ink) outer + 1px inner line 5px inside (outline: 1px solid var(--ink); outline-offset: -9px); column dividers 1px solid var(--rule); 宜/忌 boxes 2px solid var(--accent).
tokens.shadow: none. Ink only; seal edges may be roughened with an SVG filter, never shadowed.

must: At least one block set vertically (writing-mode: vertical-rl) and read right to left.
Two inks dominate: black + red make up ≥ 90% of the non-paper colour (light palettes).
A 宜/忌 or date-box structure organises the facts.
Calendrical dates in Chinese numerals when the content is Chinese.
mustNot: No fortune-telling or invented auspicious judgements — 宜/忌 hold practical do / avoid items from the facts.
No dragons, lanterns or clip-art "Chinese" decoration; ornament is frames, fish-tails and seals.
No sideways-rotated Chinese characters in vertical text.
No gradient gold or 3D metallic effects.

voice.description: 配方书写法：配料清单 + 有序步骤 + 时间/温度，任何介绍都写成"做法"。
voice.example: ① 前一晚 21:00 喂酵种 ② 次日 06:00 入炉 ③ 230°C 烤 40 分钟。

layout.name: Tear-off day sheet
layout.description: The page is one daily sheet: a giant date numeral, lunar/ganzhi columns at its sides, 宜/忌 boxes at the foot; further sections are the following sheets.
layout.grid: Sheet 3:4 portrait, max 720px; header band 15%; numeral zone 55% flanked by two 18%-wide vertical columns; 宜 | 忌 halves in the bottom 25%.
structure: Header band: Gregorian year and month, weekday; red for Sundays and holidays
Giant date numeral (a key date or number from the facts) between vertical columns: 农历 date, 干支, solar term
宜 / 忌 boxes: 宜 lists what to do (offers, actions from the facts), 忌 lists constraints
Bottom strip: one short line from the facts, and a perforation line
Following sheets stacked below, one per section, each with its own date box

anchor.name: 宜/忌 split
anchor.description: The first screen is the split: 宜 and 忌 at 20vw, each heading a list of facts.

type.name: ZCOOL XiaoWei + Limelight
type.notes: 1930s Shanghai poster voice: ZCOOL XiaoWei for the issuer’s name and month names, tracking 0.1em; Limelight for Latin (issuer name, month abbreviations) uppercase +0.06em and for numerals inside the month blocks. Chinese body Noto Serif SC 16px/1.8.

stacks.body: "Cormorant Garamond", "Noto Serif SC", Garamond, Georgia, serif

palette.name: Celadon poster
palette.usage: 月份牌 pastel: celadon ground; cream panels for calendar blocks; jade for borders and month names; persimmon accent2 for dates and the seal; ink for text.

lines.verdict: large text / UI marks only (≥24px or bold ≥19px)
large text / UI marks only (≥24px or bold ≥19px)

density.description: 常规阅读节奏；区块之间用明确的分隔（线、色块或编号），不靠空白硬撑。

motion.name: Ink soak
motion.description: Red characters print first at 60% opacity with blur(0.6px) and settle to crisp full ink, like ink soaking into paper.

motif.name: Cinnabar seal
motif.description: A square cinnabar seal (red fill with white relief characters, or red outline intaglio) carrying 2–4 characters from the facts, edge roughened via feTurbulence + feDisplacementMap.

surface.name: Rice paper
surface.description: Thin rice paper with faint diagonal fibres and specks.
surface.css: background-color: var(--paper); background-image: repeating-linear-gradient(105deg, rgba(120,90,40,.035) 0 1px, transparent 1px 7px), radial-gradient(rgba(120,90,40,.05) 1px, transparent 1.5px); background-size: auto, 5px 5px;

twist.description: 至少一条 8px 以上的粗线（或双线）作为主分区手段，替代空白。

trace.note: primary branch (or its family) already used in this roll; walked forward 1 step(s)
